summary: Labcorp said Tuesday that it has agreed to acquire Myriad Genetics’ prenatal health testing business for $210 million. The deal covers tests for assessing fetal risk of certain conditions and other aspects of prenatal care. Labcorp expects the tests to add about $160 million in revenue in year one. Evercore ISI analysts see room for Labcorp to improve the economics of the acquired business using its infrastructure and to broaden access to the tests through its provider relationships.
